basic_details.job_title: NIT Srinagar Student Internship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, National Institute of Technology Srinagar (an autonomous Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India), invites applications for one Student Internship post in a SERB-sponsored project (File No. EEQ/2023/000585). content_sections.heading: NIT Srinagar Student Internship at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Srinagar, Department of Civil Engineering
B.Tech / M.Tech in Civil Engineering with CGPA of at least 6.5 (see below)
Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Srinagar, Hazratbal, Srinagar

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email to [email protected] . The subject line must clearly mention "Application for the post of Intern under SERB funded project". The notice lists the mode of application as "Online", but the way to apply it describes is email. For clarifications, contact Dr. Sandeep Samantaray, Principal Investigator, Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Srinagar-190006 (J&K), email [email protected] , contact no. 9583322304.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one Student Internship post. Tenure is two (02) months and the emolument is ₹ 5,000/-per month. Students in the final year of B.Tech in Civil Engineering with a minimum CGPA of at least 6.5 up to the last completed semester; or students pursuing M.Tech in Civil Engineering with a BTech CGPA of at least 6.5; or students who have passed BTech/M.Tech in Civil Engineering with a CGPA of at least 6.5. Candidates should possess a foundation in Water Resources Engineering, Hydrologic modelling techniques, statistical analysis, GIS and interpretation. A student in the final year of M.Tech must bring a no-objection certificate from the competent authority. Candidates who are already employed should produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer. The position is purely temporary. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled application form (the proforma attached with the notice, with a recent passport photograph and signature, and covering academic records, NET/GATE scores if any, and publications or conference participation if any). CV with latest contact details, date of birth, qualifications, research experience and publication details (if any). Scanned copies of mark sheets, degree certificate, experience certificate, CSIR/UGC/NET or GATE certificate, valid identity proof etc., as one zip/rar file.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee shortlisting. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. The interview shall be tentatively conducted in the month of December 2026. The date, time and venue will be intimated to shortlisted candidates via the institute website only. The venue printed in the notice is the Committee Room, Department of Civil Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Srinagar, Hazratbal-190006 J&K. At the interview, the selected candidate has to produce all relevant documents and testimonials in original for verification. Failing this, the candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: CVs with incomplete application will be summarily rejected. The three files must be in PDF format and named exactly as the notice shows. The interview date, time and venue will be intimated via the institute website only.

faq.question: Q1. How many Student Internship posts are there at NIT Srinagar?
faq.answer: The notice mentions 1 post of Student Internship in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 26-11-2026 (26 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Final year B.Tech Civil Engineering students with a CGPA of at least 6.5, M.Tech Civil Engineering students with a BTech CGPA of at least 6.5, or those who have passed BTech/M.Tech in Civil Engineering with a CGPA of at least 6.5.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the pay for the internship?
faq.answer: The emolument is ₹ 5,000/-per month for the two-month tenure.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, CV and scanned certificates to [email protected] by 26-11-2026, as three PDF files named as the notice shows.

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should the email carry?
faq.answer: The subject line must clearly mention "Application for the post of Intern under SERB funded project".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and project requirement, then interviewed. The interview is tentatively in December 2026, and details will be intimated on the institute website.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the position is purely temporary, with a tenure of two (02) months.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is an NOC required?
faq.answer: Final year M.Tech students must bring a no-objection certificate from the competent authority. Candidates who are already employed should produce an NOC from the present employer.
